articles.body:
Just pulled my first event card and want to check I have this correct please, I pulled the 'resolve crisis + 3' disc.  Looking at the picture am I right in thinking it would be a rebellion as the tail is in a dominated region and the head in the capital with the same colour flag.  If so I have 2 for the attackers plus 3 from card to make 5, the defender I have 1 defence as the other empire building only has the top and no tower pieces.

As it was a success I remove the silver flag from the attackers tower and close all open orders in that region as well.  If they are already closed do a cascade.

Any guidance would be very much appreciated thank you.

articles.body: That's correct, but note that it doesn't matter how many tower pieces are in Punjab.  Only the Capital's tower counts towards defense in a rebellion.  During Invasions or when the company attacks, that's when an Empire would count all it's towers together.
